source_title: Celtic: O'Neill on McGregor comments, 'divides' & Falkirk trip - BBC
source_excerpt:
Celtic manager Martin O'Neill has been speaking to the media as his side prepare for Sunday's Premiership game at Falkirk (13:00 GMT).
O'Neill is in "total agreement" with Callum McGregor after the captain said Celtic lack a "a nailed-down profile" for attacking positions, with strikers often deployed out wide, leading to a lack of control and "basketball" games.

He probably would play off somebody strong alongside him, I'm not so sure he could lead the line on his own.
